name: r-bundle-research
description: One entry that enables the plugins every R research project uses on every session: r-project-core, r-geospatial, r-reporting, r-code-review and r-package-dev. Enabling it enables those; r-package-dev in turn pulls the r-lib skills it defers to. It carries no framework: add r-bundle-targets for a {targets} pipeline, and r-bundle-spades or r-bundle-landis for a simulation project. It ships no skills or hooks of its own.
